band_definition: A cell is assigned the first band (highest min_soh_pct) whose threshold is less than or equal to its latest observed SOH.
disclaimer: Informational health status only. It is not a certified safety diagnosis and must not be used as the sole basis for operational decisions.
limitations: Bands are project-defined and are not manufacturer limits.
A single latest SOH value ignores rate of change and operating context.
No cell-level safety event or field failure is inferred.
